summary: Airwallex is financial services company, founded in 2015. About 2,300 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 10 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 3 about funding; 1 about acquisitions; 7 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Fast-growing global payments fintech valued at $11B; sales-heavy Amsterdam jobs in English, hybrid 3 office days, and an IND sponsor.

culture.text: Hybrid working with 3 days a week in the Amsterdam office, plus equity and uncapped commission for sales roles.

open.text: Airwallex (Netherlands) B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Says more than 676,000 businesses use it, and describes itself as an $11B company on a clear path to IPO.
Committed $43 million to expand in the UAE.
Plans to double its Malaysia workforce in 2026.

worth_knowing.text: US Republicans have doubled down on attacks over Airwallex's links to China.
Its president said the company plans to become 'IPO-ready'.
